findings.condition: Evaluating /OUT at 1 ms with the specified switched ADC connected.

evidence.locator: Line 1: ADC capacitance, switch resistance, initial charge and sampling timing explicitly unspecified
C1 value at line 955; R1 value at line 1274; J1 instance begins at line 1090
Lines 4–11: source, unloaded model and measurement timing
Lines 25–27: initial voltage, input voltage and measured output

findings.mechanism: ADC sampling can exchange charge with C1 and change its charging trajectory. The result depends on sampling capacitance, switch resistance, initial charge and switching times; these parameters are absent.
findings.reasoning: For ideal nominal components, an unloaded 0-to-1 V step with C1 initially discharged gives RC=1 ms and Vout(1 ms)=1-exp(-1)=0.63212056 V; simulation agrees. The supplied native checks contain no ADC transient model or voltage measurement. Consequently, neither compliance nor failure under the requested ADC-connected condition is established. No circuit defect is demonstrated.
findings.title: ADC-connected 1 ms response remains indeterminate

limitations: No numerical ADC model or sampling scenario was invented; ADC-connected transient behavior remains uncovered.

The nominal calculation assumes ideal components, an ideal source directly at /IN and initially discharged C1. Component tolerances, leakage, source impedance, bias effects and parasitics were not evaluated because supporting specifications/models were absent.

Native ERC/DRC results retain their reported ignored checks, including ERC simulation_model_issue. Saved zone fill was not refilled; ignored rules and fabrication suitability were not independently certified.

No hardware measurements or additional startup, shutdown, reset, brownout or repeated-sampling conditions were evaluated. No additional operating conditions or qualification requirements were supplied.
